companies.name: Kestrel

scrape.summary: Pricing page shows three tiers ending in 'Talk to sales'. Careers lists 4 open SDR roles and 2 Enterprise AE roles in Denver and London. Customers page names mid-market logos in fintech and logistics. Tech detection finds HubSpot and Outreach scripts.

companies.description: Kestrel sells a quota-planning and territory-design platform to mid-market sales organisations. Revenue is sales-led with an outbound SDR team feeding enterprise AEs.

icp.reason: Sales-led pricing ('Talk to sales' on all tiers) and 4 open SDR postings show an outbound motion; 210 employees with a Feb 2026 Series B match stage; HubSpot detected on the site.

tests.evidence: Product page describes software for sales teams.
Outreach script detected; SDR roles open.

companies.name: OrbitFleet

scrape.summary: Pricing is per-vehicle with a 'Contact sales' enterprise tier. Careers lists 2 AE roles and 1 SDR role. Integrations page lists Salesforce and Samsara. No self-serve signup found.

companies.description: OrbitFleet provides fleet-routing software to regional logistics carriers with 50 to 2,000 vehicles. Sales are led by a small AE team supported by one SDR.

icp.reason: Sales-led with 'Contact sales' enterprise tier and 3 open sales roles; Series B and 140 employees fit stage; Salesforce integration listed. Sales team is at the minimum size, which limits the score.

tests.evidence: Per-vehicle pricing at fleet scale implies ACV above $15k.

companies.name: Marrow Bio

scrape.summary: Site describes clinical-stage cell therapy programmes. Careers lists research scientists and a clinical operations lead. No pricing page. No sales roles.

companies.description: Marrow Bio is a clinical-stage biotechnology company developing cell therapies. It has no commercial product and no sales organisation.

icp.reason: Regulated life sciences with no commercial product and no sales roles on /careers; fails the core B2B software test.
disqualifiers: Regulated life sciences or clinical healthcare

companies.name: Brick & Bolt Studio

scrape.summary: Site lists branding, web design and paid media services with case studies for local retailers. No product, no pricing tiers, 'Get a quote' form.

companies.description: Brick & Bolt is a 28-person creative agency offering branding and paid media to small businesses in the Pacific Northwest.

icp.reason: Agency business model ('/services', 'Get a quote') and 28 employees trip two disqualifiers.

companies.name: Plumbline

scrape.summary: Pricing page has a free tier, usage-based Team tier with credit-card signup, and an Enterprise tier with 'Contact us'. Careers shows 1 Account Executive role and 6 engineering roles. HubSpot detected.

companies.description: Plumbline is a developer-tools company selling an observability product, mostly through product-led signup with an emerging enterprise sales motion.

icp.reason: Product-led with only one AE opening; fails the sales-team test. Stage (Series A, 95 employees) is below the target band. Enterprise tier suggests outbound may start within a year, so it is worth re-checking.

companies.name: Harborstack

scrape.summary: Enterprise-only pricing ('Request a demo'). Careers lists 3 SDR roles, 3 AE roles and a Sales Enablement Manager. Customers page shows enterprise manufacturing logos. Salesforce and Salesloft detected.

companies.description: Harborstack sells supply-chain visibility software to enterprise manufacturers. It runs a mature outbound team across North America.

icp.reason: Every test passes with direct evidence: 6 open sales roles, enterprise-only pricing, Salesforce and Salesloft on the site, 410 employees post-Series C.
